# Mediabunny 1.61.1

Unmodified browser release `mediabunny.min.mjs`, MPL-2.0.
Source commit: `922054aaac0bfe5e48545a46205038d6e73dc0d1`.
Release: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/releases/tag/v1.61.1

The bundle was downloaded from that exact release and locally verified against
its publisher digest. `source.tar.gz` contains unchanged matching `src`, `shared`, `scripts`,
package manifests, TypeScript configuration and LICENSE from `git archive` of
that commit; upstream example/test media are excluded. Upstream source remains
available at https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/922054aaac0bfe5e48545a46205038d6e73dc0d1.

No runtime CDN, package fetch, or modified third-party source is used.
`tests/export-dependency.test.js` verifies all three durable file hashes.
